theorem mvcc.idxRestore_rev {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log + 1 < 2 ^
    63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2 ^ 63)
    (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (hne : log ≠ []) (i : Nat) : i ≤ cs.length → List.foldl
    mvcc.idxRestoreEnt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)) (List.filterMap (fun j => Option.map (fun kv
    => { rev := { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑j }, tomb := (cs.getD j
    (mvcc.Change.del [])).isDel, kv := kv }) (mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑(List.length log))
    (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs j)) (List.range i)) = mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev
    (List.length log) (List.take i cs))

theorem mvcc.idxRestoreEnt_step {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length log + 1 <
    2 ^ 63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log → c.length < 2 ^
    63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) (hne : log ≠ []) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) {kv :
    EtcdKv} (hkv : mvcc.changeKv (W64 ↑(List.length log)) (mvcc.stateAfter log) cs i = some kv) :
    mvcc.idxRestoreEnt (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i
    cs))) { rev := { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑i }, tomb := cs[i].isDel, kv := kv
    } = mvcc.idxApply (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log) (List.take i
    cs))) { rev := { main := W64 ↑(List.length log), sub := W64 ↑i }, change := cs[i] }

theorem mvcc.idxRestore_logEnts (rl : List (List mvcc.Change)) : rl.length < 2 ^ 63 → (∀ (cs : List
    mvcc.Change), cs ∈ rl → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) → mvcc.LogWf' rl.reverse → mvcc.idxRestore
    (mvcc.logEnts rl.reverse 0 rl.reverse.length) = mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf rl.reverse)

theorem mvcc.findKey_none_of_idxGet_none {log : mvcc.Log} {cs : List mvcc.Change} (hl : List.length
    log + 1 < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hcsl : ∀ (c : List mvcc.Change), c ∈ log →
    c.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' (log ++ [cs])) {i : Nat} (hi : i ≤ cs.length) (k :
    GoString) (h : mvcc.idxGet (mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log ++ mvcc.evsOfRev (List.length log)
    (List.take i cs))) k = none) : mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges (W64 ↑(List.length log))
    (mvcc.stateAfter log) (List.take i cs)) = none

theorem mvcc.changeKv_put_new {r : w64} {b : List EtcdKv} (hb : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess b) {cs :
    List mvcc.Change} {i : Nat} {k v : GoString} {l : w64} (hc : cs[i]? = some (mvcc.Change.put k v
    l)) (hnew : mvcc.findKey k (mvcc.applyChanges r b (List.take i cs)) = none) {kv : EtcdKv} (hkv :
    mvcc.changeKv r b cs i = some kv) : kv.key = k ∧ kv.createRev = r ∧ kv.version = W64 0 + W64 1

theorem mvcc.changeKv_isSome (r : w64) (b : List EtcdKv) (hb : List.Pairwise etcdKvLess b) (cs :
    List mvcc.Change) {i : Nat} (hi : i < cs.length) : ∃ kv, mvcc.changeKv r b cs i = some kv

theorem mvcc.idxRestore_logEnts' (log : mvcc.Log) (hlen : List.length log < 2 ^ 63) (hcs : ∀ (cs :
    List mvcc.Change), cs ∈ log → cs.length < 2 ^ 63) (hwf : mvcc.LogWf' log) : mvcc.idxRestore
    (mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log)) = mvcc.indexOf (mvcc.evsOf log)

theorem mvcc.logEnts_snoc (log : mvcc.Log) (cs : List mvcc.Change) : mvcc.logEnts (log ++ [cs]) 0
    (List.length log + 1) = mvcc.logEnts log 0 (List.length log) ++ mvcc.entsOfRev (List.length log)
    (mvcc.stateAt (log ++ [cs]) (List.length log - 1)) cs
